selection: Only complete locally certified scientific matches: original contour/owner descriptions, class correspondence, source SHA, recorded frame and candidate bbox. Candidate bboxes are locators, not accepted physical segmentation; no private metadata or source pixels.

matches.actual_source_correspondence: Small closed oval, right descent and low left free tip immediately before a separately headed open crook/lower bowl. Short-foot form precedes it; the tall loop is after the open crook. The hook has no rising return branch.

Round bowl after two open angular/barred heads, connected right descent curving left to a short exposed tip. The lower-row open crook/humps are separated from that low tip; no returned branch in the completed visible contour.

Compact round head after two angular barred/cup forms; own right descent ends in left-facing free tip above the following row. Next long diagonal/left-bowl body is independently headed at right; it supplies no terminal to focal body.

Inclined rounded bowl following a pointed leaf. Its own right-side stem descends down-left, turns at the bottom, then rises obliquely toward/across that same stem. Short open right-lobes above/right do not provide the return. Next-row long diagonal/left bowl is separate below/right. Original wider primary context, not the tight focus box alone, contains defining return.

Rounded bowl among stacked lobes and short-foot forms; continuous right side descends to left free tip. Stacked-lobe neighbor remains at head/body height, and the following short-foot body has its own terminal. Original wider context locates the bowl despite narrow bbox offset.

Small separate rounded bowl immediately before a short-foot body; right descent curves to an exposed leftward free tip. Earlier long-loop candidate is separate across visible gap. No second returned branch enters focal stem.
